verdict.rationale: Ramp documents its own audit log. Write operations, including approvals and edits made via MCP and the CLI, land in it automatically, and an audit_logs:read scope is exposed. However, the evidence frames this mainly around agent and API actions rather than a per-expense trail across all channels. missing for 10: documented per-expense history of edits, approvals and policy-check outcomes across all channels including the UI, evidence of retention, export or immutability suitable for external auditors, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, every expense carries a full audit trail — edits, approvals, policy checks — that survives an external audit

citations.quote: Every action respects the authenticated user's role and lands in the Ramp audit log.
Audit log — every write operation lands in the customer's Ramp audit log automatically, no extra wiring
Full attribution — every action traces back to the agent that took it.
